verdict.rationale: CoreWeave offers on-demand and Spot GPU capacity that it markets as quick to spin up. The docs show provisioning through the Cloud Console, Terraform, or the CKS API, with kubectl access via a generated kubeconfig. However, the provisioning unit is a managed bare-metal Kubernetes cluster plus Node Pools rather than a standalone instance, so running code requires cluster setup and Kubernetes workflows, and quota limits may require an increase request. Missing for 10: a direct single-instance provisioning path, documented or hands-on evidence of time-to-running-code in minutes, and independent corroboration of the on-demand spin-up experience.
